Name: DUELIST
Summary: A blade in one hand and nothing in the other, moving faster than the answer.
Overview:
A Duelist fights with one hand and keeps the other free, and the free hand is the point. Everything they have is bought with the room a single blade leaves them: the footwork to be somewhere else when the answer comes, the balance to swing again after a swing that missed, and the trained manoeuvres nobody with two hands on a haft has the time for.

They excel at deciding what an exchange is about. A Martial Move is not a bigger attack, it is a chosen one: a leg opened up, a guard drawn away, a weapon on the floor. A Duelist knows more of them than anybody else does and changes them out every night, so the answer they have ready is the one this fight needs rather than the one they trained for.

A Duelist’s presence is a source of quiet pressure. Nothing they do looks like much on its own, and at the last two of those chosen strikes ride the same swing, which is where all of it stops looking like nothing.
